# Normal

> > Normal is a hospitality and brand experience consultancy specializing in luxury hotel branding, sustainable tourism development, and operational excellence for partners including Marriott International, The Luxury Collection, and JW Marriott across Asia-Pacific markets.

Based across Tokyo, Singapore, and Indonesia, Normal delivers end-to-end brand identity, visual design, and experiential programming for luxury hospitality projects. The firm combines strategic brand development with sustainable living principles, working with major hotel groups and independent developers to create distinctive guest experiences and operational frameworks.

## Key Topics

- Luxury hospitality branding
- Marriott International partnerships
- The Luxury Collection hotels
- JW Marriott operational excellence
- Brand identity & visual identity
- Brand experience design
- Sustainable tourism development
- Tokyo & Singapore markets
- Hospitality design
- Service standards & leadership training
- Guest experience optimization
- Creative concept development
- Art curation (Pamela Longobardi)
- Indonesia resort planning
- Asian luxury markets

## Luxury Hotel Brand Development

- [Brand Identity, Visual Identity & Brand Experience](https://normalco.co/brand-identity-visual-identity-brand-experience): Luxury Collection Tokyo hotel branding for Tobu Railways & Marriott
- [Brand Identity & Brand Experience](https://normalco.co/brand-identity-brand-experience-3): Ginzakōka Luxury Collection Tokyo brand creation for TOBU Railways
- [Brand Identity & Brand Experience](https://normalco.co/brand-identity-brand-experience-2): Cicada Luxury Hotel Ubud conversion to Marriott Autograph Collection
- [Brand Identity & Brand Experience](https://normalco.co/brand-identity-brand-experience): Early childhood education brand for Sanskardham Foundation, Ahmedabad
- [Concept, Brand & Visual Identity](https://normalco.co/concept-brand-visual-identity): NoLo! naturalist bar & café brand creation for NOLO Group in Seoul
- [Creative Concept and Brand Experience](https://normalco.co/creative-concept-and-brand-experience-design): Wellness community brand experience for 1000 Island Hotels & Resorts
